title: Unstable Manifolds of Stratified Euler Equations
summary: We consider a spectrally unstable steady state $(ρ_0,v_0)$ of the incompressible stratified Euler equations on a class of $d$-dimensional domains. Assuming that the linearized equation admits an exponential dichotomy with a reasonably large spectral gap relative to the maximal Lyapunov exponent of the background steady flow $v_0$, we construct the local stable and unstable manifolds of $(ρ_0,v_0)$.
